design_and_population: Within-participant personalized-theta auditory stimulation in adults aged 60-75 years
matched_cognitive_or_behavioral_outcome: Yes; task accuracy, response time, and inverse efficiency
rationale_and_claim_boundary: Supports matched target-engagement, acute-performance, coupling, and participant-held-out prediction analyses; does not establish endogenous entrainment, mediation, long-term efficacy, or disease modification.

design_and_population: Cross-modal attention task with simultaneous 36-Hz visual and 40-Hz auditory tags in healthy adults
matched_cognitive_or_behavioral_outcome: Yes; trial accuracy and response time
rationale_and_claim_boundary: Provides metric- and level-matched aggregate ITPC-to-behavior validity tests plus separate trial-state validity and participant-held-out prediction. Aggregate ITPC reliability is not transferred to the trial-state score; the small participant sample limits precision.

design_and_population: 27/40-Hz auditory steady-state oddball recordings in autistic children, typically developing children, and unaffected siblings
matched_cognitive_or_behavioral_outcome: Yes; reconstructed d-prime and full-scale IQ
rationale_and_claim_boundary: Provides a larger, developmentally distinct matched aggregate ITPC-to-d-prime test plus complementary local-SNR validity and prediction. It is not treated as a replication of the primary intervention effect or as evidence about diagnostic efficacy.

design_and_population: Resting-state EEG in Alzheimer disease, frontotemporal dementia, and control groups
